notes.title: Spookitchen Playtest Now Open! (Aug 13 – Aug 31)
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello, this is YNOT![/b][/p][p]We’re here to bring you the latest news about our spooky-cute cooking tycoon, [b]Spookitchen[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546660/8603d1c5da1b4c31ef7bf27d23f0d08a18f5e264.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]🎃 1500+ Wishlists![/b][/h1][p align="start"]We hit 1[b]500 wishlists[/b]![/p][p align="start"]Thanks so much for all the love and support.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]🎃[/b]Playtest Open (Aug 13 – Aug 31)[/h1][p]From [b]August 13 to August 31[/b], the Spookitchen playtest will be available on Steam![/p][p]Unlike our previous closed recruitment on Discord, this time there’s no need to sign up — you can jump right in and play as soon as the playtest goes live.[/p][p]We’re opening it up so that folks discovering us through BIC can easily try the game from our Steam page.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]🎃[/b]We’re heading to BIC![/h1][p]Spookitchen will be exhibiting at the [b]Busan Indie Connect Festival (BIC)[/b]![/p][p][/p][h2][b]BIC Online Exhibition[/b][/h2][p]📅 Aug 8 – Aug 29
If you have a BIC online ticket, you can play Spookitchen on the BIC website.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546660/ed0de0d5c1e0b5714ab44759e1a5a8e87efe6785.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]BIC Offline Exhibition[/b][/h2][p]📅 Aug 15 – Aug 17
📍 BEXCO Exhibition Hall, Busan
We’ll be running a playable booth for Spookitchen at BIC![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546660/88f047be44bdae51461ae74b8283a3bde9f2b62e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]🎃GIGDC First Round Passed[/b][/h1][p]Spookitchen has passed the first round of the [b]Global Indie Game Development Contest (GIGDC)[/b]![/p][p]Thank you so much for all your supportive comments.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]🎃Update Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p]Compared to the first playtest, the core content hasn’t changed much — but we’ve made several improvements to reduce overall fatigue and guide players more naturally through the game, including level design reworks and an updated tutorial.[/p][p]One major change: previously, you could receive random phone calls in the kitchen — even while exploring dungeons — forcing you to run back. Now, we’ve added a [b]Phone Order Gauge[/b] so you can take calls whenever you want. We’ve also added a [b]Pause menu [/b]and [b]Return Portal[/b] to improve convenience.[/p][p]We’ve introduced a tutorial for the order-and-delivery cycle early in the game, rebalanced levels, and streamlined playtime from about 2–3 hours to around 1–2 hours.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Return portal in dungeons[/p][/*][*][p]Rhythm game added to cooking mini-game[/p][/*][*][p]New area: Backyard[/p][/*][*][p]Pause menu with ESC[/p][/*][*][p]Move all to storage / move all to inventory functions[/p][/*][*][p]Order tag filtering[/p][/*][*][p]Additional tags added based on extra ingredients when cooking[/p][/*][*][p]NPC animations[/p][/*][*][p]Graphics options & performance optimization with occlusion culling[/p][/*][*][p]Notice when Popularity Bar is full and victory is possible[/p][/*][*][p]Popularity progress bar now previews today’s gained popularity[/p][/*][*][p]Order management UI now shows order status preview[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Changed to taking orders manually by spending Phone Order Gauge[/p][/*][*][p]Cancelling an order now decreases popularity[/p][/*][*][p]Updated character voice sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Dungeon and map layouts adjusted, reduced map length[/p][/*][*][p]Mines now open 24/7[/p][/*][*][p]Forfeiting a round now counts as a loss[/p][/*][*][p]Improved seed planting convenience[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced and redesigned levels[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UI/UX visibility and readability[/p][/*][*][p]Updated windmill cooking animation[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to preview recipes with Alt while cooking[/p][/*][*][p]Edited dialogue and retranslated English/Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Improved movement, jump speed, and overall feel[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed display error for Advanced Stardust Dispenser[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sound effect volume adjustment bug[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]🎃[/b]Plans Moving Forward[/h1][p]We’ll continue refining the build to make it more appealing and prepare a public demo. Planned work includes:[/p][list][*][p]Adding story and intro[/p][/*][*][p]Opening new areas[/p][/*][*][p]More balancing and level design work[/p][/*][*][p]Creating background music[/p][/*][*][p]Uploading the demo to itch.io and other platforms[/p][/*][*][p]Adding more language translations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone supporting Spookitchen!
See you soon in our quirky little ghost restaurant! 👻👻[/p][p]- Dev Team YNOT[/p]

notes.title: Looking for Playtesters!
notes.content: [p]Hey there, [b]YNOT[/b] here![/p][p]We're a two-woman dev team from Korea making our first game, [b]Spookitchen[/b].[/p][p]It's a cute and spooky [b]ghost delivery restaurant game[/b] with a Halloween theme![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546660/21c6bd41be2e133ca383b5cf7bec1ee523c4607c.gif"][/img][/p][h1]🎃 [b]500+ Wishlists![/b][/h1][p]We hit [b]500 wishlists[/b] 2 months after launching our [b]Steam page[/b] in March![/p][p]Thanks so much for all the love and support.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]🎃Selected by the KOCCA[/h1][p]Spookitchen has been selected for the 2025 Indie Game Development Support Program by the Korea Creative Content Agency![/p][p]We're gonna make spookitchen even better for you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]🎃Looking for Playtesters[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546660/783af0fc26124c379e5595f707df8f038b198cc1.gif"][/img][/p][p]We're doing a [b]playtest[/b] on Steam this June.[/p][list][*][p][b]Playtime:[/b] About 2 hours[/p][/*][*][p][b]Languages:[/b] Korean, English, Japanese[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]How to join:[/b] We'll post on Discord[/p][/*][/list][p]👉 Unlike the demo, the playtest will be distributed via special access keys.[/p][p]More details coming soon on Discord![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]🎃Discord Now Open![/h1][p]Join our [b]official Discord[/b] to chat with everyone and give us feedback![/p][p]Come hang out and talk about Spookitchen.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]🎃What's Next?[/h1][p][/p][h3][b]Exhibitions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]July : BitSummit (Kyoto, Japan) – pending application[/p][/*][*][p]August : BIC Festival (Busan, Korea) – pending application[/p][/*][*][p][i]Final confirmation to be announced later[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Release Schedule[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Playtest : Planned for June[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Demo : Planned for August (maybe)[/p][/*][*][p]Full release: TBD[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll continue to share updates on our Steam Community and Discord.[/p][p]Hit that [b]wishlist[/b] button to support us![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546660/8603d1c5da1b4c31ef7bf27d23f0d08a18f5e264.gif"][/img][/p][h1]🎃FAQ[/h1][p][b]Q. What kind of game is Spookitchen?[/b][/p][p]A. It’s a mix of crafting, life simulation, and cooking tycoon genres — you run a spooky farm-to-table ghost delivery restaurant![/p][p]Cook Halloween dishes and deliver them to strange and adorable ghost customers in Spookyhollow.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. How is it different from other cooking tycoon games?[/b][/p][p]A. Unlike typical games where you gather ingredients first and then start your business, in [i]Spookitchen[/i], you collect ingredients [i]while[/i] running the restaurant.[/p][p]You’ll farm, hunt, chop wood, and mine materials — all in real-time. Time management and movement strategy are key to surviving this spooky culinary adventure.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What languages will the game support?[/b][/p][p]A. Playtest: Korean, English, Japanese[/p][p]Later: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, German, Russian, Italian, French, Spanish, etc.[/p][p][i]More languages if you want them![/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for supporting [b]Spookitchen[/b]![/p][p]Team [b]YNOT[/b] Can't wait to see you at our cute and creepy ghost restaurant! 👻👻[/p][p][/p]
